question_en: Which specs were updated by agreed TDocs at RAN2#132 (spec-change trace)?
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY a.sequence, t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})
MATCH (t)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec)
WHERE t.status = 'agreed'
RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
